newsitem.title: CHINA: Hainan Airlines says plans cooperation with Soros.
newsitem.headline: Hainan Airlines says plans cooperation with Soros.

text.p: China's Hainan Airlines Co Ltd is planning further cooperation with U.S. financier George Soros to offer air cargo services in China, Hainan Airlines chairman and president Chen Feng said on Wednesday.
"We may set up a new air cargo company or offer cargo services using Hainan Airlines' traffic rights," Chen told reporters at a media briefing.
American Aviation, an investment fund partially controlled by Soros, owns 25 percent of the registered share capital of Hainan Airlines, according to the airline.
The Chinese carrier has not signed an agreement with Soros on air cargo, but hopes to begin offering such services in 1998, Chen said.
The project is expected to require new investment of around $100 million for the first phase, he said, but gave no further details.
"Cargo is a great potential market in China," Chen said.
Hainan Airlines on Thursday will list 71 million foreign currency B shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange at an issue price of 3.90 yuan, or $0.47, per share.
